{{Top}}
A '''heat exchanger''' was a type of technology that transferred heat from location to location. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] bases on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] were served by a heat exchanger in the depths of the [[Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant]].
